en: An old Italian postal card with pre-printed Italian text at the top and a red printed stamp on the upper right, postmarked "MILANO". The card bears the coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy in the center. There is a blue circular arrival postmark in Russian and purple handwritten address text in Russian and Latin script, including "St. Petersburg". The card side shown is the address/message side only, without any photograph or illustration.
